observations.VERBOSITY_CONFOUND_RESULT: The length cap BROKE the length-tracks-rank correlation from tasks 001-002. gpt-5.4 wrote the 2nd-MOST words (725) and ranked DEAD LAST; codex wrote nearly the FEWEST (441) and ranked 3rd. Within a compressed length range, quality separated on merit, not length. STRONG EVIDENCE that the earlier correlation was mostly 'longer = more thorough = genuinely better', NOT raw verbosity bias. Good news for the grading loop's trustworthiness.
